summary: Lewis Hamilton and Ferrari's Charles Leclerc battle for supremacy as Aston Martin's transformative upgrade threatens to shake up the midfield pecking order. Fernando Alonso seizes on his team's mechanical revolution to prove the upgrades can elevate Aston Martin into genuine contention, potentially influencing his own future at the squad. A victory here could be the championship momentum-shifter either Ferrari or the upgraded Aston Martin desperately needs to claw back ground on the season's front-runners.
